# Pondy Boating - Mangrove Bay

> Premier Boat House, Mangrove Safaris & Boating in Pondicherry, India. Daily 7:00 AM – 5:30 PM.

Pondy Boating (Mangrove Bay) offers authentic 1-hour backwater boat rides in Puducherry exploring lush mangrove root canals, historic 2,000-year-old Arikamedu Roman trade port ruins, the Bay of Bengal sea beach confluence, and Puducherry harbour.

## Services & Experiences

- [Home Page](https://www.pondyboating.com/): Official portal with live pricing, vessel showcase, and instant reservations.
- [Boat Ride Packages & Prices](https://www.pondyboating.com/#rides): 1-hour signature cruises including Shared Rides (₹500/adult, ₹250/child), Couples Private Boat (₹3,000 flat), and Separate Private Vessel (₹5,000 flat for up to 10 guests).
- [Special Offers & Discounts](https://www.pondyboating.com/#offers): Seasonal coupons and family passes.
- [Boarding Location & Directions](https://www.pondyboating.com/#location): Boarding jetty located at 2nd Cross St, Marina, Vambakeerapalayam, Puducherry 605001. Free vehicle parking, clean restrooms, and private changing rooms on-site.
- [Online Boating Booking](https://www.pondyboating.com/#booking): Instant reservation with WhatsApp confirmation (+91 73974 38874). Zero advance payment required; pay on arrival at the jetty.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.pondyboating.com/#faq): Official guidelines on boat ride timings, ticket prices, safety life jackets, and weather policies.
